name: Celestial Counterfeiter
source:
Saden was plucked from one world and put into another, a more fantastical world, and discovered Ingrislia—an ancient, magical talking sword. She is a blade of justice dedicated to the execution of her people's ancient prophecy, the elimination of The Pale and The Deep, natural horrors of the world... which is perfect for the evil Saden to ignore.

Thoughts of mowing down crowds of innocent people flood Saden's mind as she grins. She's evil. But her evil is deeply flawed... she struggles to bring her horrid thoughts into fruition. When the cruel Vivu appears, the wielder of Ingrislia's twin sister-sword Carmelia, Saden's evil is truly put to the test.

[From [url=https://isahime.itch.io/celestial-counterfeiter]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
萨登从一个世界被带入另一个世界，一个更加奇幻的世界，并发现了英格里斯利亚——一把古老的、神奇的会说话的剑。她是一把正义之刃，致力于执行她的人民的古老预言，消除苍白和深渊，世界上的自然恐怖……这对于邪恶的萨登来说是完美的忽视。

当萨登咧嘴一笑时，她的脑海里充斥着屠杀无辜群众的念头。她是邪恶的。但她的邪恶有很大的缺陷……她努力将她可怕的想法变成现实。当残酷的维乌出现时，英格里斯利亚的孪生姐妹剑卡梅莉亚的持有者，萨登的邪恶真正受到了考验。

[来自[url=https://isahime.itch.io/celestial-counterfeiter]itch.io[/url]]
